agent_whitelist.description: Semicolon-separated list of desktop IDs (without .desktop part) of allowed agents.

network_nmea_enable.description: Fetch location from NMEA sources on local network.

wifi_geolocation_url.description: URL to a WiFi geolocation service compatible with the Ichnaea API. Leave empty to disable.

wifi_google_geolocation_url.description: URL to Google geolocation service. Leave empty to disable. Use only if compliant with Google's ToS.

wifi_submit_data.description: Submit network data to WiFi geolocation service on GPS lock.

wifi_submission_url.description: URL to submit data to a WiFi geolocation service with an Ichnaea-compatible API. Leave empty to disable.

wifi_submission_nick.description: Nickname to submit network data with. Must be 2-32 chars. Empty means omitted.

app_gnome_datetime_panel_users.description: gnome-datetime-panel: semicolon-separated list of allowed UIDs. Empty means all users.

app_gnome_color_panel_users.description: gnome-color-panel: semicolon-separated list of allowed UIDs. Empty means all users.

app_gnome_shell_users.description: org.gnome.Shell: semicolon-separated list of allowed UIDs. Empty means all users.

app_elementary_agent_users.description: io.elementary.desktop.agent-geoclue2: semicolon-separated list of allowed UIDs. Empty means all users.
